column1: # JuiceBar strings: every visible text, English source and Brazilian Portuguese (spec/ARCHITECTURE.md, module strings).
# Tab separated, UTF-8, LF. Lines starting with '#' are comments; the first other line holds the column names.
# {0}, {1}, {2} are positional values; the Mac app builds its String Catalog from this file (each {n} becomes %n$@).
# Times are 24-hour in both languages. Percentages carry no space ("23%").

column3: Não chega ao fim do dia: carregue antes das {0}h
